title: Delay the Resolution of Each Promise
summary: Given an array of promises and a delay in milliseconds, return an array of promises whose outcomes (fulfilment value or rejection reason) are postponed by that delay.
inputFormat: An array of promises and an integer millisecond delay.
outputFormat: An array of promises in the same order as the input.
edgeRules: Whether rejections are delayed and whether the delay runs from call time or from each original settlement is not stated in the draft.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.output: the returned promise fulfils with 4 after 50 ms
examples.note: Valid under either timing rule because the original settles immediately.

factsPresent: Output is an array of promises in input order
factsMissing: Whether rejections are delayed by the same amount
Whether the delay starts at call time or at each original settlement
questions: Are rejections delayed by the same amount as fulfilments?
Does the delay start when the function is called or when each original promise settles?
